📋 Best Practices

Based on Extreme Fabric Engine Best Practice Documentation

5 recommendation(s)

[CRITICAL] Security: Trial License Expired - Features at Risk
License status: Base (Trial Expired). After 60-day factory default license expires, new features cannot be configured.
Fix: Obtain a valid license bound to this switch's Base MAC address. Generate through Extreme Networks Support Portal. Existing configs continue running but new features cannot load post-reboot.
[HIGH] Features: Mixed IS-IS and OSPF Routing
Both IS-IS and OSPF are configured. Route redistribution requires careful filtering to prevent loops.
Fix: Use route maps with prefix lists. Run OSPF on L2VSN between tie-points for redundancy. Redistribute OSPF as ISIS external. Use accept policies to block external routes from being preferred.
[HIGH] Performance: High Number of Down Ports (36/50)
36 out of 50 ports are down (72.0%). This impacts fabric resilience.
Fix: Investigate root cause: cable issues, transceiver failures, or configuration errors. Verify physical connections and port status on connected equipment.
[MEDIUM] Management: SNMP Blocked
SNMP is explicitly blocked via boot config flag. SNMP must be re-enabled if monitoring is needed.
Fix: If SNMP monitoring is required, execute: 'no boot config flag block-snmp' and save config.
[MEDIUM] Features: QoS Configuration Review Needed
QoS decisions must be explicit in SPB environments. Default trust behavior applies (802.1p and DSCP).
Fix: Decide: Layer 2 (802.1p) or Layer 3 (DSCP) QoS? Configure QoS-level (0-6) for untrusted ports. Auto-sense enables 802.1p override by default.

#

sys msg-control action both

syslog host 1 enable

#

#

ssh

#

#


#

#

snmp-server sender-ip 10.1.200.50 10.254.40.1
snmp-server force-trap-sender enable

#

#

snmp-server user xmcsnmpv3 group "xmcv3_users"
snmp-server user orionsnmpv3 group "snmpv3_users"

# SNMP V3 NOTIFY FILTER CONFIGURATION
#


#
# SNMP V3 MIB VIEW CONFIGURATION
#

snmp-server view "readview" 1 
snmp-server view "snmpv3no" 1 
snmp-server view "snmpv3ro" 1 
snmp-server view "snmpv3wr" 1 
snmp-server view "notifyview" 1 
snmp-server view "initialview" 1 

#
# SNMP V3 GROUP CONFIGURATION
#

snmp-server group "xmcv3_users" "" auth-priv read-view readview write-view initialview notify-view root 
snmp-server group "snmpv3_users" "" auth-priv read-view snmpv3ro write-view snmpv3wr notify-view snmpv3no 

#
